_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Base-rate tape can drift one rung; F&G mid-band and no range break keep the skilled hold toward Complacency unless flows/CVD breakers fire.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicitly HOLD toward Complacency; narrative silent on forward phase so no conflict
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 45-55 and BTC drifts without range break or vol expansion
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed breaks under 40 with ETF flows near zero and CVD suppressed, or reclaims above 60 on positive ETF-flow reversal
